free_tier.stated: No free tier: a paid plan or prepaid credits are required to launch a computer. Without a subscription, credits are bought in USD 10, 25 or 50 packs, expiring 12 months after purchase, and a standard computer runs at USD 0.12/hour billed by the second; starting anything needs at least USD 0.25 of credit.
free_tier.notes: The operator list's $0.12/h is the pay-as-you-go Standard computer rate for 2 vCPU / 4 GB. The Solo plan is $29/month for a pool of 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM and 80 GB across up to 4 computers.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is a running virtual machine, not a stored object; files up to 2 GiB can be uploaded into a computer, and a pay-as-you-go computer allows up to 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM and 80 GB each

retention.stated: Scheduled snapshots are opt-in and bounded by the plan's window: 7 days on Solo, 7 daily plus 4 weekly on Studio, adding 12 monthly on Swarm. A computer out of credit for 30 days may be deleted, with an email warning at least seven days before.

egress.terms: Each computer can serve a port on its own HTTPS address under mandala.dev, open to anyone with the link or private to signed-in account users; the pricing page states no separate egress volume allowance or per-GB traffic price.

interface_detail: A REST API with Python and TypeScript SDKs, a mandala CLI, an MCP server for coding agents, a graphical Linux desktop with screenshot/click/type controls and an embeddable live view.
tooling: The user installs the Python or TypeScript SDK or the mandala CLI, or connects an agent over MCP; each computer is a hardware-isolated Linux VM.
chaining: Persistent desktop VMs let an agent use a browser and desktop applications across sessions, with snapshots for recovery, alongside inference records that supply the model calls.

limits.value: No free tier: prepaid credits in $10, $25 or $50 packs, expiring 12 months after purchase; $0.12/hour for a Standard 2 vCPU / 4 GB computer, $0.03 per vCPU-hour plus $0.015 per GB-hour and $0.10 per GB-month of disk
Pay as you go runs up to 8 computers sharing 8 vCPU / 16 GB RAM and 160 GB storage, up to 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM / 80 GB per computer, 1 seat

limits_note: Monthly plans: Solo $29 (4 computers, 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 80 GB pool), Studio $99 (16 computers, 16 vCPU / 32 GB / 320 GB), Swarm $399 (32 computers, 64 vCPU / 128 GB / 640 GB). A built-in computer-agent run stops after 60 minutes.
binding_note: Prepaid credits are required before any computer starts and are what run out first; at zero credit running computers are suspended or stopped with disks kept, and nothing new starts.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page offers an email field, a password of at least 8 characters, and Continue with GitHub or Continue with Google. Credits and plans require payment; the terms and payment page are not gated by a phone number or ID document on the pages read.

reliability_note: Out-of-credit computers are suspended with sessions saved or stopped with disks kept; a computer out of credit for 30 days may be deleted with an email warning at least 7 days before. Snapshots count against snapshot storage, so a long schedule can leave less room for manual snapshots.
confidence_note: Prices, credit expiry, per-computer caps, snapshot windows and sign-up fields are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25. Egress volumes are not published.
